intro: Cain Firesong is a Forsaken mage trainer located in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. He assists fledgling practitioners of the arcane as they grow in power, guiding them before directing them onward to deeper studies in the Undercity. He can be found on the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern.

p: While many Forsaken spellcasters delve into shadow or necromancy, Cain Firesong maintains mastery over traditional arcane disciplines. Stationed in Brill, he serves as an early mentor to Forsaken mages venturing forth from Deathknell. The local Deathguards direct visitors to the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern, joking that he arrived too late to get a room.

As novice mages under his tutelage advance beyond their preliminary studies in Tirisfal Glades, Cain ensures they do not stagnate. He directs his most capable students to seek out Anastasia Hartwell, a master sorceress residing in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
